wholePhysicalScope: The outer polygon establishes four projecting towers and the attached north church; the mapped inner outline fixes the courtyard.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain all four corner towers, the central open cloister and the northern bell tower.
limitations: Standing convent, sanctuary and courtyard exterior. The surrounding public terraces and interior rooms lie outside scope.
Exact heights, minor roof junctions and concealed elements are estimated from photographs.
